pages.title: Category Lattice
pages.text: Objects connected by arrows, with the only rule being that arrows compose. Numbers, spaces, groups and programs all form categories, and theorems about one often transfer to the others. The lattice looks almost bare: dots and arrows, and nothing else.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I noticed that function graphs, power sets and axiom schemas all had the same shape: things and maps between them. The Formal Proof Assistant abstracted that shape into a lattice of objects and arrows.
